correctness.rationale: Let T_h be the lexicographic h-fold product of C3 with itself. Four-round EF equivalence of G,G' transfers to C3[G],C3[G'] because Duplicator matches each outer block and uses a separate q-round local strategy; equality and arcs hold within blocks and cross-block arcs depend solely on the outer cycle. Complete ordered tuple orbits (length up to four, including repeated vertices) are determined by pair first-difference depths plus directed differences: independent digit rotations at ternary prefix nodes realize every matching record. Thus one representative per record and its set of one-point-extension records gives an exhaustive finite game recursion, with terminal atomic diagrams. An independent implementation computed orbit counts for h=1..5 respectively (1,1,3,9,27), (1,1,5,29,189), (1,1,7,61,631), (1,1,9,105,1497), (1,1,11,161,2931), and root rank-four types [I,II,III,IV,IV]. These are complete finite orbit sets, NOT samples. T4≡4 T5 therefore pumps to every height >=4 by lexicographic congruence; h=1,2,3 have distinct root types. This establishes exactly four theories and sharp largest smallest-in-family representative 3^4=81, with pure arc/equality language and exactly quantifier rank four. No higher-rank or arbitrary-tournament assertion is made.
